All above works' optimal effect on the reliability of composite services is demonstrated through the experiments.

articleTitle: Adaptive synchronization of fractional order Lü chaotic system with uncertain parameters
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper deals with adaptive synchronization of fractional order Lü chaotic system with uncertain parameters. Based on the stability theory of fractional order systems, sufficient conditions for adaptive synchronization of the uncertain Lü chaotic system are given analytically. Numerical simulations show the effectiveness of this method in a class of fractional order chaotic systems.

articleTitle: Effects of instable propagation medium on the coherence of high frequency synthetic aperture sonar
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In order to investigate the effects of the temporal instability and spatial non-uniform of the sonar propagation medium on the imaging of synthetic aperture sonar (SAS), the dynamic variation of sonar propagation medium is studied through measuring the phase stability of SAS signals in this paper. At the same time, the effects of the instable sonar propagation medium on the SAS signal coherence as well as its limitation to the size of synthetic aperture are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on relay selection based on statistical channel state information
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A relay selection algorithm is proposed to improve the system performance based on statistical channel state information(CSI) in amplify-and-forward(AF) cooperative networks. An exact and upper bound ergodic capacity formulation were derived for AF relay selection network. Theoretical analysis and simulation results validate the Tightness and feasibility of upper bound ergodic capacity.

articleTitle: The research on extraction efficiency of LED by lateral surface triangle roughening
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The external quantum efficiency of GaN-based LED is low because of the total reflection between air and semiconductor. Many research groups have being working on developing effective methods to improve the extraction efficiency of LED and the surface roughening is one of them which can efficiently improve the efficiency of LED. In this paper, we calculate the extraction efficiency by roughening the lateral surface with photon tracking method. The simulation results show that lateral triangle surface roughening is able to improve extraction efficiency of LED greatly.

articleTitle: Vibration faults diagnosis for centrifugal ventilator based on DDAGSVM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Multi-class algorithm based on Support Vector Machines, which is also called as Decision Directed Acyclic Graph method, is used for ventilator faults diagnosis in order to diagnose the vibration faults of centrifugal ventilator and improve ventilator run security and economical efficiency. Results indicate that the method is a novel means to ventilator faults diagnosis, which can not only diagnose common vibration faults accurately but also it has some features which are faster diagnosis rate and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: An improved method of HRL based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: An improved method of hierarchical reinforcement learning which named BMAXQ was presented in order to resolve the shortcomings of MAXQ. It amended the abstract mechanism of MAXQ and utilized the peculiarities of BP neural network. This method can make agent to find the subtasks automatically and realize parallel learning for every layer. It can be adapted to the learning task during the dynamic environment.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Security threats in sensor network and their possible solutions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm for .NET programs watermarking based on obfuscation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel software watermarking based on obfuscation for .net programs' security. At first, we utilize the integer factorization algorithm to divide intermediate language code into several blocks. Secondly, it uses dictionary-order algorithm to obfuscate the order of these blocks. Thirdly, we use the thought of zero-watermarking technology to embed watermark to prove the program's copyright. Finally, we insert the unconditional branch instruction that preserve the program's semantics. Experimental results demonstrate our method not only have efficient robustness, but also provide a feasible solution for the design of software-watermarking arithmetic in low-level programming language.

articleTitle: Application of grey relation degree in rotor's fault identification
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: After deeply researching the relation between reason and symptom of rotor's fault, a novel fault identification method is proposed based on grey relation degree. Firstly, the sampled data is transformed by FFT in frequency domain. Secondly, the interested frequency band is selected by harmonic window decomposition. Thirdly, the energy distribution of each frequency band is calculated. Different fault type corresponds with different energy distribution. Finally, the grey relation between the symptom set and standard fault set is calculated as the identification evidence for fault diagnosis. The practical results show that this approach is quite efficient. It's suitable for on-line monitoring and diagnosis of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: The judgment of funds image dinition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In medicine, whether the fundus image is clear or not would affect the doctor's diagnosis of the disease. In this paper, the feature vector of clear or blurred image is constructed by the fundus image edge degree and the transformed energy of the wavelet coefficients. The fisher criterion is adopted in order to determine the optimal projection direction and boundaries of the classifier threshold to classify the clear image and fuzzy image. The method has certain reference for image clarity with similar image feature judgment.

articleTitle: TV commercial segmentation using audiovisual features and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Commercial management is an emerging technology. Most of the previous works are focus on detection of commercial blocks, while ignoring the segmentation of commercials which is an primary step of funding the known commercial database. In this paper, we transform the problem to commercial boundary detection, and propose a novel method to fuse audio and visual features to find the individual commercial boundary. Audiovisual features such as FMPI (Image Frames Marked with Product Information) and speaker change probability are extracted for each shot boundary. And then, contextual features which are generated from these basic audiovisual features are used to predict the probabilities of commercial boundary for every shot boundary. At last, a post-processing method is utilized to refine the result. Experiments show a promising result on a commercial database from TV channels in China.

articleTitle: A new type of GPR high resolution step system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty on echo sampling when GPR is used for sub-bottom survey, equivalent time sampling is adopted to design the echo signal collecting system. Meanwhile, a new type of step system is presented which is based on cascaded AD9500. The step system can not only realize high resolution detection, but also give consideration to samples and sampling interval selectable. The experiment results indicate that the new type circuit is stable.

articleTitle: A new type of blender based on magnetic transmission technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Blenders with mechanical transmission system always have problems such as sealing wear and leakage etc. so magnetic transmission might be a good alternative solution. Structural design of the new blender has been made, i.e. the selection and layout of the magnetic circuit, the magnetic gap, magnetic rotor length-radius ratio, the thickness of magnet and magnetizer have been studied.

articleTitle: Research on the price prediction in supply chain based on data mining technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Through using data mining methods, we can find useful hidden trends and relationships in the mass data. This can help supply chain companies to improve the quality of decision-making on supply chain management with the gained knowledge. Take the supply chain product polyester filament as an example, through the influence factor analysis of polyester filament price; this paper uses data mining methods to predict the prices of polyester filament. The established predictive models and analytical results can be used in the supply chain enterprises and as the basis of macro-control on the chemical fiber industry of and relevant departments.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: A high resolution FPGA-based TDC with nonlinearity calibration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Machine fault feature extraction based on wavelets and recurrence quantilification analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents a simple and efficient machine fault feature extraction approach based on the wavelet transform and recurrence quantification analysis (RQA). This approach first decomposes the signals into several layers using discrete wavelet transform (DWT), then features are extracted from each decomposition based on RQA. The features contain the informative attributes of the signals. Then, machine faults are diagnosed based on these feature vectors using a probabilistic neural network. In the experimental process, features are extracted by 3 ways, DWT, RQA, and DWT combined with RQA. The experimental results from the DWT combined with RQA on bearing fault diagnosis have shown that the proposed approach is able to effectively extract important intrinsic information content of the test signals and increase the overall fault diagnostic accuracy as compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Application of decision support system based on data warehouse in sales management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In order to provide policy-makers in sales management and decision analysis more efficient and more timely information, it is necessary to study the application of decision support system based on data warehouse in the sales management. First reviewed in this paper are the concepts of the data warehouse and decision support system discipline. Then, a general decision support system framework is established based on data warehouse. Finally, the sales management decision support system design scheme is constructed with the multidimensional data model of star structure as the precondition, the enterprise marketing decision-making problems as the starting point.

articleTitle: Neonates suffocated recognition based on LDA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper come out with an infant behavior recognition scheme based on neural network. In this study, the infant face region is segmented based on the Haar Cascade Method. Two types of features, namely Mean, Variance, Skewness and Kurtosis are then calculated based on the information available from the infant face regions. Since each type of features in turn contains several different values, given a single fifteen-frame sequence, the correlation coefficients between those features of the same type can form the attribute vector of pain and normal facial expressions. Fifteen infant facial expression classes have been defined in this study. LDA corresponding to each type of those features has been constructed in order to classify these facial expressions. The experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and efficient. The properties of the different types of features have also been analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: A numerical technique based estimation and correction of frequency offset for MC-CDMA systems over AWGN channels
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Multi-Carrier Code Division Multiple Access (MC-CDMA) has been proposed as one of the air interface candidates for the fourth generation wireless communication systems. However, MC-CDMA systems suffer a lot of performance degradation due to carrier frequency offsets. In this paper proposes a Numerical Technique based on the secant method for blind Maximum-Likelihood (ML) estimation of carrier frequency offset in MC-CDMA Systems over Additive White Gaussian Noise channels (AWGN). The proposed technique is characterized by low complexity and fast convergence while maintaining the estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Suffocate infant behaviour recognition scheme based on neural network classifier
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper come out with an infant behaviour recognition scheme based on neural network. In this study, the infant face region is segmented based on the skin colour information. Two types of features, namely Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and Power Spectrum are then calculated based on the information available from the infant face regions. Since each type of features in turn contains several different values, given a single fifteen-frame sequence, the correlation coefficients between those features of the same type can form the attribute vector of pain and normal facial expressions. Fifteen infant facial expression classes have been defined in this study. Neural Network corresponding to each type of those features has been constructed in order to classify these facial expressions. The experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and efficient. The properties of the different types of features have also been analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: K-nn algorithm for fast infant pain detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, pain assessment is explained and reviewed for detecting facial changes of patient in a hospital in Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (ICU). The facial changes are most widely represented by eyes and mouth movements. The proposed system uses color images and it consists of three modules. The first module implements skin detection to detect the face. Secondly, extracts the features of faces by processing the image and measuring certain dimensions face regions based on the FFT. Finally a knn classifier used to classify the movements. From the experiments, it is found that the identification rate of reaches 90.12%.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Performance evaluation and compression of some actuators and sensors piezoelectric elements
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper describes three types of piezoelectric structures that can be used as an actuator and as a sensor. These types are the Bender Element, the Plate Transducer and the Trigger-Accelerometer. Variations in usage, the internal structure and the direction of polarization are explained in order to understand the differences between the types and the responses of the piezoelectric structures. Among the many methods that are used for analyzing and building the transfer function of piezoelectric structures, the lumped parameter model was chosen as the method of analysis. This method proved very active in analyzing the effects of the internal parameters such as the dimensions of the piezoelectric structure and the elastic constant for the output response. In addition, after the transfer functions of the actuator and the sensor were built, the effect of the input signal types to the actuator and the sensor, such as the sine wave and pulse were analyzed. Finally, the results that were obtained, were compared with other previous works, and the results were very close.

articleTitle: Research on cooperative navigation for multiple UUVs
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: When multiple unmanned underwater vehicles(UUV) are in close proximity, only a few of multiple UUVs are equipped with high precise proprioceptive localization sensors and others can but be equipped with low precise ones for the reason of cost. Though rough localization can be achieved by a dead-reckoning(DR) system, the latter can acquire measurement information by the means of two modes with the former for improving localization accuracy. Two modes are required that all UUVs must carry acoustic communication equipments. One is acoustic broadcast communication in which distance measurements are obtained based on acoustic propagation time of flight (TOF). Another is detection in which distance and orientation are gained through receiving detecting echoes. Two modes both need the UUVs who have higher localization accuracy broadcast their positions in virtue of acoustic broadcast communication. The cooperative navigation algorithm based on extended Kaiman filter (EKF) can combine effectively the measurements with the rough state estimates of the DR system to make the UUV who is equipped with low precise proprioceptive localization sensors get better position estimates. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The application of FP-array in network learning mining
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: For the large visit of the network learning system and the difficulty of analyzing the correlation of learning behaviors, a high-performance mining algorithm based on FP-array is proposed. The paper also analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of FP-max based mining algorithm. This proposed algorithm could be used to the correlated data mining of the network learning behaviors to obtain the visit frequency of the learning resources, which helps to provide important reference to the improve the network learning system.

articleTitle: An auto-selection method for saliency detection and its application to segment the object
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Based on the analysis to the three methods of IG, GBVS and PQFT, and on the comparison of their advantages and disadvantages, an auto-selection method for saliency detection is proposed by calculating the consistency between two methods. The salient object in the image is separated through combining GrabCut algorithm with the saliency map generated. The results of experiments demonstrate that our method is not only has a good performance on saliency detection but also can effectively separate the salient object.

articleTitle: Development and test of advanced experimental system for stored-grain monitoring and model validation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper presents the problem of designing and testing advanced monitoring and modeling experimental system for stored grain. Firstly, system configuration is described and functions are discussed in detail. Then, accuracies of different sensors used in this system and pressure distribution uniformity are tested. In particular, a monitoring-ventilation experimental platform for grain model validation is developed, on which an experiment is carried out. Results show that, this experimental system can be effectively used for stored grain monitoring and grain model validation.

articleTitle: Dynamic circuit analysis design and simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The abstract physical analysis and the complex differential equations always make our students feel dull to the dynamic circuit study. We need a new method to change the traditional blackboard-and-text teaching. Multisim is such a practical and convenient simulation platform that can assist us to carry out this reform. With this software, we can not only strengthen our dynamic circuit theory analysis, but also direct our students to develop more practical circuits in the curriculum design. Theory analysis for a concrete dynamic circuit and its simulation with Multisim are provided in this paper. We also present a strobe light circuit analysis and design example. Simulation results validate the theory and show that our design is feasible and Multisim is powerful and practical.

articleTitle: Pain assessment using neural network classifier
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Both the timing of facial actions and the configuration are important in emotion expression and recognition. To investigate the timing and configuration of pain facial actions, in this paper, pain assessment is explained and reviewed for detecting based on skin detection using color detection and SVD as feature extraction. Finally a Neural Network classifier used to classify the movements. From the experiments, it is found that the identification rate of reaches 93.75%.

articleTitle: The reasoning research on smoke' spread between ship cabins
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The principle of smoke's spead between ship cabins is founded on the base of the characters of smoke' spread and cabins' frame connection, and the direction of smoke movement is analysed. Afterward the cabins' frame database and PRI of direction are founded, and mathematical model of smoke' spread between ship cabins is founded with the database. Finally, the simulation software of smoke' spread is compiled by Visual Basic 6.0. The software can help people judge the direction of smoke, and can provide references to shipman who choose the key nodes which can restrict smoke.

articleTitle: Study on optimizing control of flight arrival scheduling strategy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Flights arrival scheduling problem is stubborn problem in air traffic control at present. Through analyzing dynamic process of arriving flights, we make reasonable assumption and split the problem into two parts. First sequence all arriving flights in certain period, and adjust interval between arriving flights by model reference adaptive control. Simulation results show that arriving flights become steadier and smooth, which supply a new idea to deal with the problem in ATC automation in future.

articleTitle: Application of mixed finite element method to unsaturated soil water flow and flux
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, a numerical model for two-dimensional unsaturated water problems in the soil is established by the mixed finite element(MFE) method to find the density and flux of water flow simultaneously. The numerical method has been verified and compared by the numerical examples. Satisfactory results and some other significant and valuable conclusions are obtained from studies.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on the air leakage characteristics of the cover
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Xingshan Iron Mine is an underground mine turned from an open-pit one. For the practical problems in the process of cover formation, the air leakage characteristics of the cover under the conditions of different porosity were simulated with the software FLUENT and porosity was as the key parameters. The relationship between cover thickness and air leakage coefficient under the condition of different porosity was found which is of great significance to instruct the cover formation of open-pit to underground mining.

articleTitle: Application of modified subspace pursuit on guided wave NDT signal processing based on improved evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A kind of novel subspace pursuit method is proposed and applied to guided wave NDT signal decomposition and recognition to reduce the complexity of subspace pursuit. Modified differential evolution algorithm (MDEA) is applied to the modified subspace pursuit (MSP) by choosing chirplet function as match atoms. A steel pipe with hole and notch is detected by guided wave and the measured signal is decomposed and reconstructed by MSP. The matching result is compared to the matching result from OMP with evolutionary programming using mutations based on the t probability distribution (tEP). The defect echo can be identified easily from the matched signal. The matched parameters get by MSP and OMP are compared and analyzed. The defect locations are more exactly get from MSP than from OMP.

articleTitle: Research of snow detection in Northeast China based on MODIS and AMSR-E data
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Both MODIS data and AMSR-E data can be used to determine snow region. For MODIS data, the snow spectrum characteristics observed in spectral data are usually utilized to detect snow region. For AMSR-E data, the scattering signals observed in multifrequency passive microwave data are often used to determine snow region. Generally, the snow detection result based on MODIS data has better image quality because the spatial resolution of MODIS is higher than that of AMSR-E data. However, the snow detection results using MODIS data are different from the practical results of snow coverage because MODIS data are sensitive to clouds interferences. Compared with MODIS data, AMSR-E data can realize snow detection in most weather conditions for its high penetration capability. As a result, the snow detection results of AMSR-E data are more accurate than that of MODIS data. However, the main drawback of AMSR-E data is the low spatial resolution. Through researching the snow detection methods, the spatial position matching method is proposed to realize the position matching between AMSR-E data and MODIS data. Furthermore, the snow detection results using the two data are combined together to determine snow distribution in Northeast China. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method by combination of AMSR-E and MODIS data can get better snow detection results.

articleTitle: A whole fatigue analysis design about high pressure quick-open vessels on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The method of analysis design is the designing trend of chemical vessels, the whole finite element model of the high pressure quick-open vessels is built using the limit element analysis software ANSYS, strength and fatigue analysis of the dangerous parts is verified according to Analytical Design Standards for Steel Pressure Vessels (JB4732-95), in the analysis process, mechanical properties of the contact is Considered. Result shows that it satisfies the design request of the high pressure quick-open vessels working in the special condition, pressure, temperature and so on.

articleTitle: A scheme for implementation of Ethernet-like Physical Frame Timeslot Switching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of Internet and NGI and MPLS, Single physical User-data transfer Platform Architecture Network is proposed to emerge existing separated three types of networks. Ethernet-like Physical Frame Timeslot Switching (EPFTS) is the key technique in Single physical User-data transfer Platform Architecture Network. In this paper we propose a parallel switching scheme for implementing EPFTS. Its main idea is that every processing phases of the entire switching process (e.g. storing, scheduling, transmitting, lookup switching table, etc) are concurrent; they can process the different segments of an EPF at the same time. The experimental results show that the parallel switching scheme can improve the switching performance greatly when the traffic load is heavy in larger size switch.

articleTitle: Application of improved MFNN on dynamic computing for case-intelligence recommendation system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Personalized recommendation involves a process of gathering and storing information about website visitors, from which user's characteristic knowledge is exploited to satisfy the personalized needs. Facing the difficulty of timely identifying new data computing in updating real-time user behaviors, we propose a case-intelligence system framework along with a feature-based multi-layer feed-forward neural networks (MFNN) approach to personalized recommendation that is capable of handling the massive with dynamic data effectively. Our experimental results indicate that better performance in our recommender comes from the both sides: the one is that our MFNN has understandable, constructive and reliable process, unlike the black box of the other ANN networks; the other is our covering algorithm can decrease the complexity of ANN algorithm effectively.

articleTitle: An efficient hybrid routing algorithm for ZigBee networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To overcome the flaws of ignoring the energy consumption and flooding RREQ packets in the present hybrid routing algorithms for ZigBee networks, we propose in this paper an efficient hybrid routing algorithm without flooding (EHRA). EHRA sufficiently utilizes the information of nodes' neighbors and includes the depth and the residual energy of nodes in its routing metric, so as to reduce overhead and to select nodes with more remaining energy for routing. Thus network overhead is reduced and the energy consumption of nodes is balanced. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that EHRA outperforms the classical tree routing (TR) algorithm and the limited flooding ZigBee ad-hoc on-demand distance vector routing algorithm (LF-ZAODV) in terms of routing overhead, energy balance of nodes, and network lifetime.

articleTitle: Modeling of the reasonable arrangement of hospital bed and its emulation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Aiming at the reasonable arrangement of ophthalmic patients' sickbed, evaluation model of sickbed arrangement scheme is constructed based on AHP/ECM, and through programming model sickbeds arrangement plan will be improved and evaluated. In order to get better sickbed arrangement and coordination, based on the GM (1, 1) patients' admitted time prediction model has been built and the model simulation results were revised adopting enumeration method. Finally, based on the single queuing theory, the sickbed desk proportional distribution solutions have been given and the simulation has been optimized to better solve reasonable arrangement of the ophthalmic patients' sickbed.

articleTitle: Coding aware network architecture for dynamic grooming mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Account of its advantages in network throughput, load balance, network coding is introduced into the multicast traffic grooming. A core node structure with multicast splitting, traffic grooming, and encoding/decoding functions is studied, and a dynamic-multicast traffic grooming algorithm based on network coding is proposed. Simulation results show that, compared with existing multicast algorithms, in specific bandwidth granularity of service request, our algorithm improved at a great extent in the aspects of resource utilization, blocking probability.

articleTitle: Cost-effectiveness evaluation of IHEs based on GRA with triangular fuzzy numbers weighted
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Based on the practical demand of the cost-effectiveness evaluation of IHEs, this paper proposes the gray relational analysis evaluation model with decision makers' preference. In order to give full play to the subjective initiative of decision makers and take into account the fuzzy of human thought, the weighted model based on triangular fuzzy numbers is given. This paper constructs the system of evaluation index through the input, output index of the cost-effectiveness of institution of higher education and adopts the TFN-PGRA model to analyze the cost-effectiveness of 8 similar universities in one province. The evaluation results show that the model in this paper has greater advantages and applicability, it math the actual of appraised university.

articleTitle: Research the outage performance in decode-and-forward cognitive system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: An approximate outage probability formulation were derived for decode-and-forward (DF) cooperative relay networks on the premise of guarantee primary user quality of service(QoS) and limit of maximal power in cognitive user. The full space diversity is achieved on optimal relay selection strategy. By Monte Carlo simulation, the rationality of the approximate outage probability formulation is validated. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that, in cognitive system, number of relay are sources of diversity gain.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Study on a novel topology and control simulation of unified power quality conditioning techniques
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper discusses a novel topology and a new control method of unified power quality controller (UPQC), in which the conventional UPQC was divided into a voltage compensation section and a current compensation section respectively. The voltage compensation comprises a voltage source inverter connected to the power grid in series by a single-phase boost transformer. While the current compensation employs a three-phase switched capacitor connected to the power grid in parallel. In this topology, the volume and total costs of UPQC can be effectively reduced. The scheme has been proved to work by the simulation of Matlab and also have good control effect.

articleTitle: Safety system based on Linear Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: A Linear Discriminant Analysis Classifier for home security system we describe in this paper. Images were taken in uncontrolled indoor environment using video cameras of various qualities. Database contains 4,005 static images (in visible and infrared spectrum) of 267 subjects. Images from different quality cameras should mimic real-world conditions and enable robust face recognition algorithms testing, emphasizing different law enforcement and surveillance use case scenarios. In addition to database description, this paper also elaborates on possible uses of the database and proposes a testing protocol. A baseline Haar Cascade Method for face recognition algorithm was tested following the proposed protocol based on LDA Classifier. Other researchers can use these test results as a control algorithm performance score when testing their own algorithms on this dataset. Database is available to research community through the procedure described at http://www.lrv.fri.uni-lj.si/facedb.html.

articleTitle: DWCS: A Dynamic Web Cache Selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: The main aim of cache selection algorithms in current proxy servers is to get higher hit-ratio, they usually don't concern the validation and update of outdate pages. In this paper a new cache benefit model is defined, the relevant factors including validation cost and update cost are considered to obtain the optimal cache set. According to the cache model, an algorithm - DWCS (Dynamic Web Cache Selection) is presented, and it is proved to be optimal under the reasonable hypothesis. The experimental results show the efficiency of DWCS algorithm.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID control in the process control
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper introduces the advantages and disadvantages of traditional PID control and fuzzy control technology, and discusses the excellent characteristics of fuzzy PID control and the reasons which are suitable for applying in industrial process, The paper further presents the design method and realization process of PID parameters of self-tuning fuzzy controller. Finally the application example in industrial process is given. The results show that using fuzzy PID control technology in industrial process control has better dynamic characteristics, an ideal steady quality and strong anti-jamming ability, maintaining the good adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: A fast classification algorithm of walking states based on acceleration signal
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast classification algorithm of walking states based on acceleration signal. The improved and simplified recursive average filtering algorithm for acceleration data is adopted and then the mean and variance of the vertical and the forward direction acceleration is extracted. After analyzing the characteristics of different walking states, the fast classification algorithm of walking states is presented. The algorithm has many advantages, such as low computational complexity, fast execution speed and low requirement for hardware. It shows good recognition rate by the experiment results.

articleTitle: Study on control of megawatt wind turbine with variable-pitch
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper derives the relationship between drag coefficient and electrical power of generator by deducing the connection between drag coefficient and rotor power coefficient. The efficiency losing state of running is introduced to the simulation of aging of blade and control strategy and using variable-pitch control is utilized under the efficiency losing state of running. The simulation result of software Matlab display that wind turbine operates safely by using the strategy under efficiency losing state of running.

articleTitle: Research on information security risk assessment based on fault tree
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Information security has gradually become a hot issue of social concern, and the information security risk assessment has become an important issue for information security and its development. In this paper, we mainly introduced some theories about fault tree. We not only established the information security risk assessment model based on fault tree, but also adopted a military information system as an example. At last, we verified that the model had validity.

articleTitle: Application of optical phase conjugation in adaptive optics to remove atmospheric aberrations from an optical wavefront
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper deals with the correction of the phase fluctuations produced in an optical wavefront due to the particular wavefront passing through the atmosphere using the principle of Optical Phase Conjugation. This is achieved by producing the optical phase conjugated wave of the distorted wavefront by the process of degenerate fourwave mixing and making the phase conjugated wave interfere with a resultant wavefront, where the resultant wavefront is the difference between the original wavefront and the optical phase conjugated wavefront. Results are obtained using image processing in MATLAB.

articleTitle: A flexible affix byte-level string matching for network content filtering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: String matching is a classical problem in computer science. The technique is widely used in range of applications, such as pattern recognition, spelling checking, intrusion detection, worm containment, information retrieval and so on. String matching using the Deterministic Finite Automaton will be the performance bottleneck of network content filtering. We proposed a flexible affix byte-level string matching algorithm to reduce the unnecessary state transitions problem and reduce memory requirements. This proposed algorithm is based on the Byte-level string matching algorithm and it utilizes dynamic partitioning words to accelerate the matching speed. The proposed string matching algorithm was implemented in Snort for experimental performance evaluation. Comparing with the original algorithm, experimental result shows that the newly presented algorithm has gained much improvement on memory reduction, especially in detecting multiple keywords within a reliable network system.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Design of high precision digital frequency meter
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Two important features of electrical signals in time-domain are frequency and cycle, the measurement of which is an important way to understand signals. Digital frequency meter, closely relating to the measuring scheme of many electric parameters, has been widely applied to electronic experiments. The design and preparation method of a self made frequency meter with high precision is introduced. STC89C52 MCU is the core of the whole design, through which the counting, display, frequency division ratio and automatic range switching of the signals to be measured are controlled. The present design can achieve automatic display of counting, automatic range switching and measuring results. The measured results show that the maximum error rates of this frequency meter in three ranges are less than 0.1%, indicating a relatively high precision.

articleTitle: Intellectual recognition of reliability analysis model based on neural network integration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Intellectual recognition method for the reliability distribution models based on neural network integration has been studied. Normal distribution, Weibull distribution and logarithmic normal distribution are tested and analyzed. The simulation test results tell us that the intellectual recognition system has high confidence degree and high recognition rate, and is easy to be implemented in engineering.

articleTitle: Dynamic system simulation model and algorithm based on artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Artificial neural network is a theory and technology which developed rapidly in recent years in the field of computer intelligence. In this paper, artificial neural network and system simulation concepts were introduced, and proposed simulation models based on dynamic neural network and system simulation model based on process neural network, and described the learning algorithm of the model.

articleTitle: Fuzzy k-NN for choke infant detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper come out with an infant behaviour recognition scheme based on neural network. In this study, the infant face region is segmented based on the Haar Cascade Method. Two types of features, namely Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and Power Spectrum are then calculated based on the information available from the infant face regions. Since each type of features in turn contains several different values, given a single fifteen-frame sequence, the correlation coefficients between those features of the same type can form the attribute vector of pain and normal facial expressions. Fifteen infant facial expression classes have been defined in this study. Fuzzy k-NN corresponding to each type of those features has been constructed in order to classify these facial expressions. The experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and efficient. The properties of the different types of features have also been analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Early choke infant monitoring scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper come out with an infant behavior recognition scheme based on neural network. In this study, the infant face region is segmented based on the Principle Component Analysis. Two four of features, namely Mean, Variance, Skewness and Kurtosis are then calculated based on the information available from the infant face regions. Since each type of features in turn contains several different values, given a single fifteen-frame sequence, the correlation coefficients between those features of the same type can form the attribute vector of pain and normal facial expressions. Fifteen infant facial expression classes have been defined in this study. Support Vector Machine (SVM) corresponding to each type of those features has been constructed in order to classify these facial expressions. The experimental results show that the proposed method is robust and efficient. The properties of the different types of features have also been analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Research of ceramic substrate automatic sorting system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Ceramic substrate is an important substrate of electronic components. According to the shortcomings of the traditional contact measurement, ceramic substrate automatic sorting system based on machine vision is designed in this paper. It can automatically detect the ceramic substrate's size, shape and position error, and the use of mechanical and electrical integration technologies satisfies sorting technology requirement, and realizes automatic sorting of ceramic substrate. The experiment results show that the size measurement of the ceramic substrate based on visual measuring system can get clear edge image, the measurement accuracy of geometric dimensions meets the requirements. Compared with the traditional measurement methods, it improves the precision and efficiency of the sorting, and provides real-time, fast, effective and economical means of measurement, which fully embodies the advantages of machine vision measurement.

articleTitle: Turing instability for a discrete single species Lotka-Volterra system
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, Turing instability of a single discrete Lotka-Volterra system with the periodic boundary conditions is considered. Conditions for producing Turing instability of the single discrete system is attained. That is, we again certify the fact that a single diserte reaction diffusion can generate Turing instability.

articleTitle: Generalized difference simulation for solute transport problems in the soil
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: In this paper, a numerical model for solute transport problems in the soil is established by the generalized difference (GD) method. The numerical method has been verified and compared by the numerical examples. Satisfactory results and some other significant and valuable conclusions are obtained from studies.

articleTitle: Improving Naïve Bayes classifier for software architecture reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: Documentation of software architecture is a good approach to understand the architecture of a software system and to match it with the changes needed during the software maintenance phase. In several systems like legacy or older systems these documents are not available or if available; they are not up-to-date and usable. So, reconstruction of architecture in order to maintain these systems is a necessary activity. When we talk about software architecture, usually we are looking for a modular view of architecture with low coupling and high cohesion. In this paper, we try to improve the algorithm of machine-learning which is presented before for architecture recovery, and we propose using it for architecture reconstruction in order to obtain optimum modularity in the architecture with low coupling and high cohesion. The proposed algorithm is evaluated in a case study, and its results are presented.

articleTitle: A novel parallel clustering algorithm PXM based on FP-Tree
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: To solve the following practical problems in e-commerce filed: massive e-commerce data processing, fast clustering of mixed types of data, data sparseness; we present an in-depth discussion and study on the parallel cluster analysis and propose a novel parallel clustering algorithm based on FP-Tree called PXM. In the new algorithm, X-Means Algorithm is improved in two aspects: (1) the usage of MapReduce framework, by taking the appropriate parallel strategy to implement X-Means algorithm. (2) the usage of FP-Tree structure to solve the problem that a collection of type, term type, Boolean data have no definition about mean, easy to use low complexity algorithm like K-Means clustering.

articleTitle: Photogrammetric relative pose estimation with varying and unknown focal length
publicationTitle: 2012 International Symposium on Instrumentation & Measurement, Sensor Network and Automation (IMSNA)
abstract: This paper addresses on the estimation problem of relative pose from two views with the varying and unknown focal length. For statistical optimization, approximated maximum likelihood estimation in the presence of noise and measurement model is proposed under the inter-image epipolar constraint. In order to achieve a direct solution of relative pose, the fundamental matrix is reparameterized with minimal degrees of freedom. Then, we derive the analytical differentiation and adopt the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm to solve the optimization problem for efficient computation. Experiments show that the proposed method is comparable to bundle adjustment while providing a significant advantage in terms of computational cost.
